custom_expected:
Step 3: All 7 listed fields are HIDDEN.

custom_preconds: Test user: Customer Management View+Edit. Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Top nav > Customers. Open a customer.
2. Open the Edit Customer modal.
3. Scroll through the modal looking for each of these 7 field labels exactly: 'Credit terms', 'Credit limit', 'Default Labor rate', 'Default Shop Supplies', 'Min and Max', 'Taxes', 'PO is required'.
4. Look for basic customer fields (name, address, phone, email, contacts, vehicles).
title: AP/AR OFF hides the 7 sensitive customer fields on the Edit Customer modal
